The **Preprocessing** group of the node palette has 40 nodes: all run.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Advanced Augment](../preprocessing/advanced-augment.md) | Runs | Erase patches of training images, mix training images and their labels, or apply a policy. |
| [Augmentation Preset](../preprocessing/augmentation-preset.md) | Runs | A standard training augmentation recipe in one node. |
| [Center Crop](../preprocessing/center-crop.md) | Runs | Crop the middle height x width of every image. |
| [Color Jitter](../preprocessing/color-jitter.md) | Runs | Vary brightness, contrast, saturation and hue of training images. |
| [Gaussian Noise](../preprocessing/gaussian-noise.md) | Runs | Add random noise to every pixel of training images. |
| [Grayscale](../preprocessing/grayscale.md) | Runs | Turn every image into one luminance channel. |
| [Horizontal Flip](../preprocessing/horizontal-flip.md) | Runs | Mirror training images left to right at random. |
| [Image Contrast (CLAHE)](../preprocessing/image-contrast-clahe.md) | Runs | Even out contrast in every image, tile by tile. |
| [Image Denoise](../preprocessing/image-denoise.md) | Runs | Remove grain from every image while keeping edges. |
| [Image Edges](../preprocessing/image-edges.md) | Runs | Turn every image into an edge map. |
| [Image Filter](../preprocessing/image-filter.md) | Runs | Run one fixed kernel over every image. |
| [Image Gabor](../preprocessing/image-gabor.md) | Runs | A bank of striped kernels: one channel per orientation and wavelength. |
| [Image Gaussian Blur](../preprocessing/image-gaussian-blur.md) | Runs | Smooth every image with a Gaussian kernel. |
| [Image Pyramid](../preprocessing/image-pyramid.md) | Runs | Halve or double every image, or keep one level of detail. |
| [Image Rotate](../preprocessing/image-rotate.md) | Runs | Rotate training images by a random angle. |
| [Image Sharpen](../preprocessing/image-sharpen.md) | Runs | Sharpen every image with an unsharp mask. |
| [Image Smooth](../preprocessing/image-smooth.md) | Runs | Smooth every image: box, median or bilateral. |
| [Image Warp](../preprocessing/image-warp.md) | Runs | Warp every image the same way: corners, points or polar. |
| [Label Encoder](../preprocessing/label-encoder.md) | Runs | Encode one categorical column. |
| [Log Transform](../preprocessing/log-transform.md) | Runs | log(x) or log(1 + x) of number columns. |
| [Max-Abs Scaler](../preprocessing/max-abs-scaler.md) | Runs | Max-abs scaling. |
| [MinMax Scaler](../preprocessing/minmax-scaler.md) | Runs | Min-Max normalization. |
| [Morphology Transform](../preprocessing/morphology-transform.md) | Runs | Erode, dilate, open or close every image with a square kernel. |
| [Normalize](../preprocessing/normalize.md) | Runs | Centre and scale the inputs with a fixed mean and standard deviation. |
| [One-Hot Encode](../preprocessing/one-hot-encode.md) | Runs | Convert integer class indices into one-hot vectors. |
| [Ordinal Encoder](../preprocessing/ordinal-encoder.md) | Runs | Encode categorical columns. |
| [Outlier Detector](../preprocessing/outlier-detector.md) | Runs | Flag, clip or drop numeric outliers. |
| [Power Transform](../preprocessing/power-transform.md) | Runs | Box-Cox / Yeo-Johnson. |
| [Quality Analyzer](../preprocessing/quality-analyzer.md) | Runs | Leave blurry, too dark or bright, flat and near-duplicate images out of training. |
| [Quantile Transform](../preprocessing/quantile-transform.md) | Runs | Quantile transform. |
| [Random Affine](../preprocessing/random-affine.md) | Runs | Rotate, shift, scale and shear training images at random. |
| [Random Crop](../preprocessing/random-crop.md) | Runs | Crop height x width at a random place in every training image. |
| [Random Grayscale](../preprocessing/random-grayscale.md) | Runs | Turn some training images gray, keeping their channels. |
| [Random Perspective](../preprocessing/random-perspective.md) | Runs | Tilt training images as if seen from another angle, at random. |
| [Random Resized Crop](../preprocessing/random-resized-crop.md) | Runs | Crop a random box of every training image and resize it to width x height. |
| [Resize](../preprocessing/resize.md) | Runs | The size every image is decoded to for training. |
| [Robust Scaler](../preprocessing/robust-scaler.md) | Runs | Robust scaling. |
| [Standard Scaler](../preprocessing/standard-scaler.md) | Runs | Z-score standardization. |
| [Target Encoder](../preprocessing/target-encoder.md) | Runs | Target mean encoding. |
| [Vertical Flip](../preprocessing/vertical-flip.md) | Runs | Flip training images top to bottom at random. |
